title: INVENTORY
alt_text: A dark marble chamber veined with gold, lit by one round opening in the dome. The light fades and the gold veins glow, picking out a coat on a chair, a steaming cup, and a door left ajar with warm light behind it. A man in a long coat walks through the door, and the light returns.

location.name: Pantheon, Rome
location.why: One opening of light in a dark dome. As the light moves, it shows what the room still holds.

youtube.title: 026 | INVENTORY 🕯️ #philosophy #motivation
youtube.description:
Everyone wants the light back. Fair.

But look at what the dark just showed you.

The coat still on the chair.
The cup still warm.
The door that still opens.

Easy to miss in daylight. Most of us only count them after.

Count them now.

—
